title: Char Dham Yatra
content:
Yamunotri • Gangotri • Kedarnath • Badrinath
About the Yatra
The Char Dham Yatra is a sacred pilgrimage to four revered Hindu temples nestled in the Garhwal Himalayas of Uttarakhand. The journey traditionally begins at Yamunotri, the source of the River Yamuna, and continues to Gangotri, where the River Ganga is believed to have descended to Earth.
The third destination is Kedarnath, home to one of the twelve Jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva, situated at an altitude of approximately 3,583 metres. The yatra concludes at Badrinath, the sacred abode of Lord Vishnu, surrounded by the magnificent Nar and Narayan mountain ranges.
The Char Dham Yatra remains one of India’s most significant spiritual journeys. According to Hindu tradition, completing the pilgrimage in its prescribed sequence—from west to east—helps devotees seek divine blessings, spiritual purification and the path towards moksha.
Our Char Dham Yatra package is carefully planned so that pilgrims can focus entirely on their spiritual journey. Transportation, accommodation, meals and other essential arrangements are organised in advance, providing a comfortable, safe and worry-free pilgrimage.
Journey Details
Starting City: Surat
Travellers from anywhere in Gujarat can request transportation arrangements to Surat, where the main journey will begin.
Ending City: Surat
The main journey will end in Surat. Onward transportation from Surat to anywhere in Gujarat can also be arranged upon request.
Duration: 13 Days / 12 Nights
Number of Days: 13 Days
Number of Nights: 12 Nights
Price per Person: Starting from ₹30,000
Available Departures: Three scheduled departures are available each year. Please contact us for the exact departure dates.
Contact Number: +91 95868 25353
WhatsApp Number: +91 95868 25353
Detailed Day-Wise Itinerary

title: Day 1: Surat to Haridwar
content:
Starting Point: Surat
Destination: Haridwar
Meals: Dinner
Accommodation: Hotel Lakasha, Valmiki Chowk, Haridwar—or a similar hotel
Begin your sacred Char Dham Yatra from Surat. Upon arrival in Haridwar, meet the tour coordinator and proceed to the hotel. Complete the check-in process and take some time to relax after the journey.
Dinner will be served at the hotel, followed by an overnight stay in Haridwar.

title: Day 2: Haridwar to Barkot
content:
Starting Point: Haridwar
Destination: Barkot
Places Covered: Neelkanth Mahadev, Mussoorie and Lakhamandal
Meals: Lunch and dinner; breakfast only if included in the selected package
Accommodation: Economy hotel in Barkot
After breakfast, if included in your package, check out from the hotel and begin the road journey towards Barkot.
Subject to available time, road conditions and the final route, visit Neelkanth Mahadev Temple, enjoy the scenic surroundings of Mussoorie and visit the ancient Lakhamandal Temple.
Continue towards Barkot, surrounded by beautiful mountain landscapes. Upon arrival, check in to the hotel and relax. Lunch and dinner will be provided according to the travel schedule.
Overnight stay in Barkot.

title: Day 3: Barkot–Yamunotri–Barkot
content:
Starting Point: Barkot
Destination: Yamunotri and return to Barkot
Places Covered: Yamunotri Temple and surrounding Himalayan scenery
Meals: Lunch and dinner; breakfast only if included in the selected package
Accommodation: Economy hotel in Barkot
Begin the day early and travel towards Janki Chatti, the starting point of the Yamunotri trek.
Continue towards Yamunotri Temple on foot. Pony, palki and other local services can be arranged at an additional cost. After reaching Yamunotri, take darshan and spend some time experiencing the peaceful spiritual atmosphere and natural surroundings.
Return to Janki Chatti and drive back to Barkot. Dinner and overnight stay at the hotel.

title: Day 4: Barkot to Uttarkashi
content:
Starting Point: Barkot
Destination: Uttarkashi
Places Covered: Gupteshwar Mahadev and Kashi Vishwanath Temple
Meals: Lunch and dinner; breakfast only if included in the selected package
Accommodation: Hotel Himalaya, Uttarkashi—or a similar hotel
After breakfast, check out and proceed towards Uttarkashi, an important spiritual town situated along the River Bhagirathi.
Visit Gupteshwar Mahadev Temple and the sacred Kashi Vishwanath Temple. After completing the temple visits, proceed to the hotel and check in.
Enjoy dinner and an overnight stay in Uttarkashi.

title: Day 5: Uttarkashi–Gangotri–Uttarkashi
content:
Starting Point: Uttarkashi
Destination: Gangotri and return to Uttarkashi
Places Covered: Gangnani, Harsil and Gangotri Temple
Meals: Lunch and dinner; breakfast only if included in the selected package
Accommodation: Hotel Himalaya, Uttarkashi—or a similar hotel
Depart early for Gangotri Dham. During the journey, visit Gangnani, where devotees may take a holy bath in the natural hot-water spring, subject to local conditions.
Continue through the beautiful Harsil Valley, known for its peaceful environment, mountain views and the River Bhagirathi.
Upon reaching Gangotri, take darshan at Gangotri Temple and spend time near the sacred river. Later, return to Uttarkashi for dinner and an overnight stay.

title: Day 6: Uttarkashi to Sonprayag
content:
Starting Point: Uttarkashi
Destination: Sonprayag
Place Covered: Dhari Devi Temple
Meals: Lunch and dinner; breakfast only if included in the selected package
Accommodation: Hotel GMD, Sonprayag—or a similar hotel
After breakfast, begin the long and scenic road journey towards Sonprayag.
Visit the sacred Dhari Devi Temple, subject to available time and road conditions. Continue through the mountain routes towards Sonprayag, which serves as an important base for the Kedarnath Yatra.
Upon arrival, check in to the hotel, have dinner and rest in preparation for the Kedarnath trek.

title: Day 7: Sonprayag to Kedarnath
content:
Starting Point: Sonprayag
Destination: Kedarnath
Places Covered: Gaurikund and Kedarnath Dham
Meals: Lunch or packed lunch and dinner; breakfast only if included in the selected package
Accommodation: Agarwal Bhavan, Kedarnath—or similar basic accommodation
Begin the journey early in the morning. Travel from Sonprayag to Gaurikund using the authorised local shuttle or jeep service.
From Gaurikund, begin the approximately 16-kilometre trek to Kedarnath Dham. Travellers may complete the journey by walking or use pony, palki or helicopter services at an additional cost.
Helicopter travel is available only when specifically selected in the package and remains subject to ticket availability and weather conditions.
After reaching Kedarnath, check in to the available guest house or dharamshala. Attend darshan according to the available temple schedule.
Dinner and overnight stay in Kedarnath.

title: Day 8: Kedarnath to Sonprayag
content:
Starting Point: Kedarnath
Destination: Sonprayag
Place Covered: Triyuginarayan Temple
Meals: Lunch and dinner; breakfast only if included in the selected package
Accommodation: Hotel GMD, Sonprayag—or a similar hotel
Attend early-morning darshan at Kedarnath Temple, subject to the temple schedule. After darshan, begin the return trek towards Gaurikund.
From Gaurikund, use the local shuttle service to reach Sonprayag. Visit Triyuginarayan Temple if time, weather and road conditions permit.
Check in to the hotel at Sonprayag, followed by dinner and an overnight stay.

title: Day 9: Sonprayag to Pipalkoti
content:
Starting Point: Sonprayag
Destination: Pipalkoti
Place Covered: Tungnath Temple
Meals: Lunch and dinner; breakfast only if included in the selected package
Accommodation: Kushal Palace, Pipalkoti—or a similar hotel
After breakfast, check out and proceed towards Pipalkoti.
Visit Tungnath Temple, subject to weather conditions, temple accessibility and available time. Reaching Tungnath requires an uphill trek, so travellers should wear comfortable trekking shoes and carry sufficient water.
After the visit, continue towards Pipalkoti. Check in to the hotel, have dinner and stay overnight.

title: Day 10: Pipalkoti–Badrinath–Pipalkoti
content:
Starting Point: Pipalkoti
Destination: Badrinath and return to Pipalkoti
Places Covered: Badrinath Temple, Mana Village and Charan Paduka
Meals: Lunch and dinner; breakfast only if included in the selected package
Accommodation: Kushal Palace, Pipalkoti—or a similar hotel
Depart early for Badrinath Dham. Upon arrival, take darshan at the sacred Badrinath Temple.
Visit Mana Village and explore its spiritual and natural surroundings. A visit to Charan Paduka may also be arranged, subject to the travellers’ fitness, available time and weather conditions.
After completing the visits, return to Pipalkoti. Dinner and overnight stay at the hotel.

title: Day 11: Pipalkoti to Haridwar
content:
Starting Point: Pipalkoti
Destination: Haridwar
Place Covered: Rishikesh
Meals: Lunch and dinner; breakfast only if included in the selected package
Accommodation: Hotel Lakasha, Haridwar—or a similar hotel
After breakfast, check out and begin the return journey to Haridwar.
Visit Rishikesh for local sightseeing, subject to time and traffic conditions. After completing the visit, continue to Haridwar and check in to the hotel.
Enjoy dinner and an overnight stay in Haridwar.

title: Day 12: Haridwar to Surat
content:
Starting Point: Haridwar
Destination: Surat
Mode of Travel: Train
Meals: Lunch and dinner according to the package and train schedule
Accommodation: Overnight train journey, depending on the confirmed schedule
After breakfast, if included, check out from the hotel and proceed to the railway station.
Board the scheduled train for Surat. Lunch and dinner will be provided according to the selected package and travel schedule.
Spend the night travelling by train.

Ending Point: Surat

Arrive in Surat with the blessings of Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath.

Accommodation Information
Accommodation Category: Economy hotels, guest houses or dharamshalas

Private Room: A separate private room can be arranged upon request, subject to availability and an additional charge.
Hot-Water Facility: Hot water will be provided only where it is available at the hotel. At remote destinations, it may be supplied in buckets or during fixed hours.
Remote-Area Accommodation: Hotels and guest houses at Kedarnath and other remote locations offer basic facilities. Luxury services, room heaters, elevators and continuous hot water may not be available.
Hotel Changes: The listed hotels are preferred options. A similar-category property may be provided if the listed hotel is unavailable.

Local Transportation: Shared jeeps or authorised local vehicles may be required on routes where the main tour vehicle is not permitted.

Drop-off Point: Surat Railway Station or another confirmed location in Surat.
Travellers from Other Parts of Gujarat: Transportation to and from Surat can be arranged upon request. Applicable charges will be communicated separately.
Vehicle Allocation: The vehicle type may change according to the group size, route conditions and government regulations.
Important: Travel times may vary because of mountain roads, traffic, weather, landslides, road closures and local authority instructions.

All sightseeing visits are subject to available time and accessibility.

title: Char Dham Yatra registration and valid photo identification are compulsory.
content:
Travellers must cooperate with the tour coordinator and follow the scheduled departure times.
Helicopter, pony and palki services are controlled by independent operators and cannot be guaranteed.
The management will make reasonable alternative arrangements if any destination becomes inaccessible.
Travellers should confirm the final train details, hotel list, meal plan and departure schedule before making the full payment.
Important Yatra Information
Age Restrictions
The Yatra is open to travellers of all age groups. However, due to high altitude, long road journeys and physically demanding treks, children below 10 years, senior citizens above 60 years, pregnant women and travellers with existing medical conditions should consult a doctor before booking.
Participation may be restricted if a traveller’s health condition creates a serious safety risk.
Health Requirements
Travellers should be physically fit enough to manage long road journeys, cold weather, high-altitude conditions and trekking routes.
A medical check-up is strongly recommended before departure. Travellers with heart disease, asthma, high blood pressure, diabetes, breathing problems or other serious conditions must inform us during booking and carry their prescribed medicines.
A medical fitness certificate may be requested for senior citizens or travellers with pre-existing health conditions. All travellers must follow government health screening requirements applicable during the Yatra.
Documents Required
Please carry the following documents:
Original Aadhaar card or another valid government-issued photo ID

title: Char Dham Yatra registration letter with QR code
content:
Two recent passport-size photographs
Tour booking confirmation and payment receipt
Medical fitness certificate, if applicable
Doctor’s prescription for regular medicines
Passport and valid Indian visa for foreign nationals
Emergency contact details
Travel insurance documents, if purchased
Items to Carry
Travellers should carry:
Warm clothes, thermals, sweaters and a heavy jacket
Woollen cap, gloves, warm socks and scarf
Raincoat, poncho or umbrella
Comfortable, waterproof trekking shoes
Walking stick for the trekking routes
Personal medicines with prescriptions
Basic first-aid kit and ORS sachets
Reusable water bottle and light energy snacks
Sunscreen, sunglasses and lip balm
Small backpack, torch and power bank
Personal toiletries and hand sanitiser
Valid ID, registration letter and sufficient cash
Please pack lightly and avoid carrying unnecessary luggage.
Weather Information
Weather in the Himalayan region is cold and unpredictable. Sudden rainfall, snowfall, strong winds and significant temperature changes may occur during the Yatra season.
Travellers should carry warm and waterproof clothing regardless of their departure month. Road closures, landslides or bad weather may affect the planned itinerary. Please check the latest government weather advisory before and during the journey.
Booking Conditions
A 30% advance payment is required to confirm the booking.
The remaining balance must be paid at least 15 days before departure.
Bookings made within 15 days of departure require full payment.
Confirmation is subject to the availability of hotels, vehicles and other services.
Travellers must provide accurate personal, identification and medical information.
Government Yatra registration is compulsory. We can assist with registration, but travellers must provide the required documents on time.
Helicopter tickets, pony, palki and personal expenses are not included unless clearly mentioned in the package.
Hotel rooms and transportation will be provided according to the selected package.
The itinerary may be modified because of weather, road conditions, government instructions, temple timings or safety concerns.
Additional expenses caused by unexpected delays, road closures, natural disasters or medical emergencies shall be paid by the traveller.
The booking is considered confirmed only after the required payment and written confirmation have been received.
Cancellation Policy
Cancellation requests must be submitted in writing through WhatsApp or email.
30 days or more before departure: 10% of the total package cost will be deducted.
16–29 days before departure: 25% of the total package cost will be deducted.
8–15 days before departure: 50% of the total package cost will be deducted.
Within 7 days of departure: No refund will be provided.
No-show or leaving the Yatra early: No refund will be provided for unused services.
Non-refundable hotel, transport, permit, registration or ticket charges will be deducted separately, wherever applicable.
Approved refunds will normally be processed within 7–15 working days.
If the Yatra is affected by severe weather, natural disasters, road closures or government restrictions, an alternative date, itinerary adjustment or refund will be offered according to the cancellation terms of the respective service providers.
If we cancel the tour for reasons within our control, travellers may choose an alternative departure or receive a refund of the amount paid.
